StepFun sees only the full gold document and the hop question. It does not see the gold answer or accepted variants. The audit then checks whether StepFun's short answer exactly matches an accepted answer, and highlights cases that look underspecified, ambiguous, unanswerable, numeric-only matched, or document-truncated.
